'''September 2001 Albany tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Clifton mall, Albany, NY in September 2001. It is known from Mike Gemme's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2993">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-the-tr-writer-gets-serious-albany-9-8d2993/ the-tr-writer-gets-serious-albany-9-8], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 25 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-25-the-tr-writer-gets-serious-albany-9-8d2993/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' September 2001
* '''Site:''' Clifton mall, Albany, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
